description: This file provides utility functions for data type conversion (casting unknown values to specific types) and for resolving temporary file paths with directory creation and unique ID generation.

methods.name: export function asRecord(value: unknown): Record<string, unknown> { asRecord
methods.description: Converts a value to a Record<string, unknown> if it is an object, otherwise returns an empty object.

methods.name: export function asString(value: unknown): string | undefined { asString
methods.description: Converts a value to a string if it is of type string, otherwise returns undefined.

methods.name: export function asNumber(value: unknown): number | undefined { asNumber
methods.description: Converts a value to a finite number if it is of type number, otherwise returns undefined.

methods.name: export function asBoolean(value: unknown): boolean | undefined { asBoolean
methods.description: Converts a value to a boolean if it is of type boolean, otherwise returns undefined.

methods.name: export function resolveTempPathParts(opts: { ext: string; tmpDir?: string; id?: string }): { resolveTempPathParts
methods.description: Generates a temporary path object with extension, directory (creating it if necessary), and a unique ID, based on provided options.

ctags.name: resolveTempPathParts
ctags.pattern: /^export function resolveTempPathParts(opts: { ext: string; tmpDir?: string; id?: string }): {$/
